worksheet.title: Store Readiness Checklist
worksheet.description: Tick each building block as you complete it. Your store is ready when everything is checked.

fields.label: Platform chosen
fields.helpText: Which platform will you use? (e.g. Shopify, Etsy, WooCommerce, Big Cartel)

fields.label: Product page live
fields.helpText: Product listing from Chapter 9 is uploaded and looks correct on desktop and mobile.

fields.label: About page live
fields.helpText: A genuine, readable about page that answers: who you are, why you started, why they should buy from you.

fields.label: Contact method visible
fields.helpText: An email address or contact form is easy to find.

fields.label: Returns policy published
fields.helpText: Clear, plain-language returns and refunds policy is visible to buyers.

fields.label: Payment processing active
fields.helpText: Stripe and/or PayPal connected. A test transaction completed successfully.

fields.label: Privacy policy live
fields.helpText: Privacy policy and terms of service pages published (platform templates are fine to start).

fields.label: Store tested with a real person
fields.helpText: A friend or family member went through your store as a customer and gave you honest feedback.

fields.label: Store URL
fields.helpText: Your live store address (optional — add it when you are ready to share).
